title: HenArt Announces Launch of ‘Levendo’ Dog Food Using Enifer Mycoprotein, PetfoodIndustry
description: According to Petfood Industry, Israeli pet food company HenArt introduced Levendo, a complete dog food made with Pekilo mycoprotein, Enifer’s fermented protein ingredient. The report conveys the product launch and the fact that the ingredient was used, but it does not include independent corroborating material.

sections.heading: The Core of the Launch Report
paragraphs: According to Petfood Industry, HenArt introduced Levendo dog food using Enifer’s Pekilo mycoprotein. The original summary describes the product as a baked complete food for adult and senior dogs.

The facts confirmed in this material are limited to the product launch, the use of the ingredient, and the intended target group. Sales performance, consumer response, and reaction in the Korean market cannot be assessed from the information provided.

sections.heading: Conditional Introduction Without Independent Verification
paragraphs: Because the provided material consists of only one publisher report, FOURFEETZ does not treat this as independently verified reporting. Accordingly, the article should be handled as a conditional edit that introduces only the facts stated in the original text.

In particular, interpretations such as the ingredient’s functionality, nutritional superiority, or potential for market expansion should be excluded from the body, and speculation beyond the scope of the original text should be avoided.

sections.heading: Practical Points for the Domestic Industry to Check
paragraphs: Domestic businesses should first check ingredient naming, complete-feed standards, and document consistency across the distribution process when commercializing alternative protein ingredients.

Even when referencing overseas cases, domestic regulations and consumer understanding are separate matters, so it cannot be assumed that the same product concept would produce the same response in Korea.

takeaway: Petfood Industry reported HenArt’s launch of Levendo and the application of Enifer Pekilo mycoprotein.
Because there is no independent source in the provided material, FOURFEETZ introduces only the facts stated in the original text on a conditional basis.
Korean readers and industry players should focus first on labeling, regulations, and ingredient verification rather than on ingredient efficacy.
